| # | Action | What happens | Why it matters |
|---|--------|--------------|----------------|

- The fuel gauge will indicate the current level (e.g., 15 % of a 50‑gallon tank).
- The battery voltage will be displayed (e.g., 13.2 V), confirming the battery is healthy.
